title: Modified Rust RPL source breaks default no_std build
description: cargo check -p lichen-link -p lichen-schc -p lichen-rpl --no-default-features fails in rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs because DaoReceivedRoutes aliases std-gated HashMap, Vec, DaoTarget, and DaoTransit outside cfg(feature="std"). Restore the project's default no_std contract by gating the alias and cleaning cfg-specific imports/uses, then run no-default and all-feature check/test/clippy gates.
